mapper.select: SELECT d.*, s.name AS student_name, s.student_no FROM archive_destination d LEFT JOIN student s ON d.student_id = s.pk_student WHERE d.pk_destination = #{pkDestination}
SELECT d.*, s.name AS student_name, s.student_no FROM archive_destination d LEFT JOIN student s ON d.student_id = s.pk_student WHERE d.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_destination (student_id, destination_type, destination_name, destination_address, contact_person, contact_phone, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{destinationType}, #{destinationName}, #{destinationAddress}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE archive_destination SET destination_type = #{destinationType}, destination_name = #{destinationName}, destination_address = #{destinationAddress}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone} WHERE pk_destination = #{pkDestination}

UPDATE archive_destination SET status = #{status}, send_user_id = #{sendUserId}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, send_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = '已寄出' THEN NOW() ELSE send_time END WHERE pk_destination = #{pkDestination}
